note: The one catalog rule whose runtime materialization R7-B.2 changed. B0-C06 condition 8 (and SSCTR D08, clinical-screen-first) was contradicted on the QE-R7B1-04 path (R7-A's late-evidence question before the substitution's clinical screen) and on the two same-class exits found by the contract §4 inventory (R7B2-CAND-01, the factual re-plan's own question; R7B2-CAND-02, the return's report-identity question). This entry records what now materializes it: one precedence point in evaluateProgram's decision step that returns the clinical route the review's own handler screen takes, through the two screens the handlers share with it. The base and R7-B.1 entries keep their consumers and tests.
